• Commander game format: 2–5 players, approx. 120 minutes of play time
Product description

This bundle contains all 5 Magic: The Gathering Starter Commander Deck sets – First Flight (White-Blue deck), Grave Danger (Blue-Black deck), Chaos Incarnate (Black-Red deck), Draconic Destruction (Red-Green deck) and Token Triumph (Green-White deck).

Each Starter Commander Deck set contains 1 ready-made deck of 100 Magic cards – with 1 foil-etched legendary Commander card with alternate art and 99 non-foil cards including lands, 10 double-sided tokens, 1 deck box, punchout counters, 1 insert with strategy recommendations for the deck, a summary of the rules for playing Commander, and 1 reference card with guidance on what to do on your turn.
Instructions for use

Follow these steps to use the Starter Commander Decks: Step 1: Choose one of the 5 decks included in the bundle. Step 2: Take the cards out of the deck and sort them. Step 3: Hand out the decks to the players based on the number of players (2–5). Step 4: Each player chooses a commander from their deck and sets it aside. Step 5: Each player shuffles their own cards and draws 4, then chooses one of the 4 as their starting hand and puts the other cards back. Step 6: Each player takes their commander from the command zone and brings it into play. Step 7: Start playing by following the rules of the Commander format.
